annotations.annotation_text: The nocturnal oneiric dimension (Night): Joyce's exploration of the sleeping body, sensory deprivation, auditory distortions, and the somatic language of the collective unconscious.
sources: Bishop, John. Joyce's Book of the Dark. https://archive.org/details/joycesbookofdark0000bish

annotations.annotation_text: Universal archetype of the father and everyman protagonist Humphrey Chimpden Earwicker (HCE), manifested here as "Earwicker". Represents the recumbent Dublin landscape with head at Howth and body stretching west to Phoenix Park.
sources: Glasheen, Adaline. Third Census of Finnegans Wake. https://archive.org/details/thirdcensusoffin0000glas
McHugh, Roland. The Sigla of Finnegans Wake. https://archive.org/details/siglaoffinnegans0000mchu
James Joyce Digital Archive: Finnegans Wake Notons. https://jjda.ie

annotations.annotation_text: The theme of the cosmic and comic Fall (Fall): Tim Finnegan tumbling from his ladder, Humpty Dumpty shattered from the wall, and Adam falling in Eden, awaiting whiskey-fuelled resurrection.
sources: The Ballad of Tim Finnegan's Wake. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Finnegan%27s_Wake
Atherton, James S. The Books at the Wake. https://archive.org/details/booksatwake0000athe
Opie, Iona and Peter. The Oxford Dictionary of Nursery Rhymes. https://archive.org/details/oxforddictionary0000unse_m4u1
